description:
HushTelegram v0.0.19 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.3 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the Google Play build 13.0.3 (org.telegram.messenger) with 67 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. This release makes the Google Play build patchable, the one most people already have, since Morphe Manager used to turn it away with "Wrong package selected." The official beta isn't a target anymore.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 1348 runtime tests passed locally. All 481 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 67 patches applied to Telegram 13.0.3 without forcing, both telegram.org's build (version code 71839) and the Google Play build (version code 71831), and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.3 or the Google Play build 13.0.3. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram, patch 13.0.3 and install it over your current build with the same signing key. On the beta, switch to telegram.org's build or the Play build first. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** The Google Play version of Telegram 13.0.3 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 71831) can be patched now. That's the APK APKMirror and Uptodown carry, and Morphe Manager used to turn it away with "Wrong package selected" because it only knew telegram.org's build. telegram.org's build still works the same way.
* **Telegram:** **Repair Firebase push registration** also covers the Play build, so its notifications sign up with Google like they do on telegram.org's build.
* **Telegram:** The official Telegram beta isn't a target anymore. **Turn off beta debug logs** is gone with it, and so is the part of **Disable analytics** that only stopped the beta's crash and session reports. If you're on the beta, switch to telegram.org's build or the Play build before you patch.
